recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11313; future molecular variation example work should be handled as new CG/MolecularDefinition work, not as restoration of retired Sequence.variant or CIGAR guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11313 was a Published FHIR-core Sequence change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2, asking for clearer Sequence.variant guidance and examples. The accepted clarification said the variant definition came from Sequence Ontology, that variants could represent some complex variation with a CIGAR string, and pointed to a complex-variant example.
initial_application: Git commit fb0ea8d18ee237629fa22ec31cc42676b10c8383 explicitly mentioned #11313 and revised source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml to add Sequence Ontology, complex variation, and CIGAR wording. Commit 78abae0217bc20d5f1be80d0d32224d679432862 then carried the concept forward when Sequence was renamed to MolecularSequence and the sequence-complex-variant example was registered.
additional_context: Sequence is listed under removed resources in source/fhir.ini, molecularsequence is commented out for CG, CG maps to moleculardefinition, and diagnostics-module.html says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition. FHIR-37414 later removed MolecularSequence.relative.edit.cigar and its example value, the complex-variant example was deleted, and the MolecularSequence folder was removed in 2025. Current MolecularDefinition source models sequence differences with relative edit operations and profiles for sequence, allele, and variation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Restoring Sequence.variant text, CIGAR, or the old example would be outside the current build scope and would conflict with later published CG decisions and MolecularDefinition refactoring.
